title: Bentness of the mod-two inner-product function
statement: For every natural number $n$, the function on pairs of $n$-bit vectors that maps $(x,y)$ to $(-1)^{\langle x,y\rangle}$, with the inner product computed modulo $2$, is bent on the $2n$-dimensional binary cube: every Fourier coefficient has absolute value $2^{-n}$.
